<xbrli:xbrl xmlns:xbrli="http://www.xbrl.org/2003/instance"
            xmlns:iso4217="http://www.xbrl.org/2003/iso4217"
            xmlns:ex="http://example.com/taxonomy">

  <xbrli:context id="C1">
    <xbrli:entity>
      <xbrli:identifier scheme="http://example.com/entity">ABC_LTD</xbrli:identifier>
    </xbrli:entity>
    <xbrli:period>
      <xbrli:startDate>2025-04-01</xbrli:startDate>
      <xbrli:endDate>2024-03-31</xbrli:endDate>
    </xbrli:period>
  </xbrli:context>

  <xbrli:unit id="U1">
    <xbrli:measure>iso4217:XYZ</xbrli:measure>
  </xbrli:unit>

  <ex:Revenue contextRef="C1" unitRef="U1" decimals="0">-500000</ex:Revenue>
</xbrli:xbrl>

<xbrli:xbrl xmlns:xbrli="http://www.xbrl.org/2003/instance"
            xmlns:iso4217="http://www.xbrl.org/2003/iso4217"
            xmlns:ex="http://example.com/taxonomy">

  <xbrli:context id="C1">
    <xbrli:entity>
      <xbrli:identifier scheme="http://example.com/entity">XYZ_CORP</xbrli:identifier>
    </xbrli:entity>
    <xbrli:period>
      <xbrli:instant>2024-13-01</xbrli:instant>
    </xbrli:period>
  </xbrli:context>

  <xbrli:unit id="U1">
    <xbrli:measure>iso4217:usd</xbrli:measure>
  </xbrli:unit>

  <ex:Assets contextRef="C1" unitRef="U1" decimals="INF">1000000.50</ex:Assets>

  <ex:Liabilities contextRef="C2" unitRef="U1" decimals="0">400000</ex:Liabilities>
</xbrli:xbrl>
